structured_output.summary: The acceptance criteria are met. `IfRange.check`, clamping and first-range use in `make_content_range`, and removal of the `is_byte_range_valid` import are all implemented and tested. `ETagSet.from_header` already discarded invalid values, so the new test only pins that behaviour. One advisory: a formatting slip in `tests/test_http.py`.

findings.text: The `test_content_range_invalid_int` parametrize line was rewritten without a space after a comma (`"*/🯱🯲🯳","1-+2/3"`), which is formatting noise that `ruff format` would reject; restore the original line.
No test covers `IfRange.check` with a naive `last_modified` datetime (assumed UTC) or with a non-bytes unit passed to `make_content_range`.
